title: Incorrect file object check
detail: The condition skips processing when fp is not None, which is the opposite of the intended defensive check. This causes valid file-like objects to be ignored and potentially raises errors later.

title: Missing breakpoint updates when one list is empty
detail: The new _set_breakpoints method only runs when both horizontal_breakpoints and vertical_breakpoints are truthy. If only one of them is defined, the method exits early and no breakpoint classes are added or removed, breaking the intended behavior of updating styles on resize.

title: Return type changed, ImportError may be raised
detail: The function now returns a ModuleType unconditionally, but if the vendor module cannot be imported importlib.import_module will raise ImportError instead of returning None. Existing callers that expected None will now crash.
